title: The Peninsula Golf Weekend
dek: Two nights at Jackalope, one round at St Andrews Beach, vineyard meals and a short coastal alternative for non-golfers.
dayLabels: Check in and dinner on the ridge
Golf and a shared vineyard lunch

bookingChecklist.item: Early Saturday tee time at St Andrews Beach
Friday Doot Doot Doot dinner and Saturday Montalto Restaurant lunch
Check Sunday opening and tasting availability at Ten Minutes by Tractor

variations.label: If you are not playing golf
variations.body: Take the short Cape Schanck Boardwalk while the golfers play St Andrews Beach, then allow time to drive from the cape to meet everyone at Montalto for lunch.

editorNote: Friday check-in at Jackalope begins at 3 pm. Saturday splits the group: players take an early tee time at St Andrews Beach while non-golfers can visit the short Cape Schanck Boardwalk, then everyone meets for a prebooked Montalto lunch. Confirm the round length and travel time before setting the lunch reservation; The Piazza is a less formal fallback if timing slips. Stay a second night at Jackalope. Sunday's coffee stop in Mornington followed by the Main Ridge cellar door doubles back, so skip either stop if you prefer a direct journey home.

stops.note: Arrive Friday from the hotel's 3 pm check-in and settle in for the first of two nights. Confirm the next morning's tee time and route before dinner.
Friday dinner at the hotel restaurant. Sets the weekend up as an event rather than a golf grind.

Book an early Saturday tee time at this public-access course and confirm the expected round length. Agree on transport and a realistic Montalto lunch meeting time with non-golfers, who can spend the morning on the Cape Schanck Boardwalk instead.
Meet for a reserved Saturday Restaurant lunch after the round. Set the seating only after checking the tee time and likely travel from Fingal; The Piazza can be a more flexible fallback.
Sunday brunch in Mornington. The cafe opens at 8 am and closes at 3 pm on weekends; check the current kitchen hours before setting off.
One cellar door before the drive home. Serious pinot noir and chardonnay. The ridge sending you off.
